body.intent: Fix rhiza run resume --retry on a ship-change run that failed at ci-triage can never recover once the PR is green. Run 01M6XVTXGJAMQRBZKDZKY0Z01T (PR #393): pr-green failed because GitHub refused every CI job for billing (no test ran), so ci-triage ended 'exit 1, no failing test was recorded for the head: an infra or unparsable failure' and the run failed. After billing was fixed, one rerun turned PR #393 fully green, but 'rhiza run resume --retry' restarts at ci-triage, which re-reads the stale state and fails again in 1s (journal: retried ci-triage, visit 2, outcome fail). The retry should re-evaluate the PR first: when the head (or a new head) is green, continue at pr-green/rebase; an infra-only failure (no failing test) should send the run back to wait on CI rather than end it. Unstuck by hand: merged origin/main in the run worktree, pushed, then rhiza ship check / ship land / ship merge.
